title: Claim Frequency on an Enrolment and the Loading on a Restoration Charge
content:
An enrolment on the Keyturn Host Protection Plan that has drawn a number of accepted claims carries a loading on the charge for restoring its cover.

- Where the claims accepted on the enrolment in the twelve months before reach the number the plan allows before cover is suspended, the charge carries the marketplace's high-frequency loading of 1.5 times the figure.
- Where they reach the number the plan allows before the enrolment goes in front of a reviewer but not the number before suspension, it carries the review loading of 1.2 times the figure.
- Where they reach neither, no loading is carried on that account.

### The two numbers each plan publishes

| Plan | Claims allowed before review | Claims allowed before suspension |
|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 2 | 4 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 2 | 4 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 3 | 5 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 3 | 5 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 4 | 6 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 5 | 8 |

### Worked readings (hypothetical figures, on a charge of 100 before this step)

On the Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan, whose published numbers are 3 and 5, two accepted claims in the twelve months before carry no loading and leave 100.00; three or four carry the review loading and leave 120.00; five or more carry the high-frequency loading and leave 150.00.

### The record the reading is taken from

The claims counted are the appraisals accepted on this enrolment within the twelve months before.
